title: felix-canary crash-loop state (/data/services/felix-canary/state/crash-loop.json)

history.description: Dominance-compacted candidate baselines: strictly ascending time, strictly increasing count; history[-1] is the latest observation; all entries within the last window are kept, plus at most 64 older entries no older than 24 h.

last_alert_utc.description: Time of the last alert/reremind ATTEMPT (no retry, research R-08).

generation.description: boot ID (system/user) or container ID (container) of the latest observation.

boot_id.description: Host boot ID under which this unit was last observed; a mismatch rebases the unit (research R-06).

updated_at_utc.description: The pass `now` that wrote this document (deploy verification freshness).

boot_id.description: Host boot ID at the writing pass (systemd generation).

description: Load is fail-safe: missing, corrupt, non-object, or unknown schema_version loads as empty (every unit first-seen, no alert). Each unit entry is validated semantically and a malformed entry is dropped individually; any time later than now+60s makes the entry malformed (research R-07).
